paraphrase: Recollecting Amitābha single-mindedly for seven days and nights, the practitioner sees him face to face, in samādhi or in a dream; then he understands: the buddha did not come and I did not go; this triple world is made by mind; what I think, I see; mind makes the buddha, mind sees itself.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge at chapter level; passage not read in a local text in this phase.
